newsitem.title: USA: F.Y.I. Inc acquires two companies.
newsitem.headline: F.Y.I. Inc acquires two companies.

text.p: F.Y.I. Inc said Thursday it had acquired MAVRICC Management Systems Inc and an affiliated company, and Input of Texas Inc.
F.Y.I. said it issued a total of 1,083,636 shares in exchange for all of the stock of MAVRICC and Input.
The deals will increase F.Y.I.'s revenues by about $13.5 million. Annual revenues for MAVRICC and Input are $8.8 million and $4.7 million, respectively.
Both transactions qualify for pooling-of-interests accounting.
F.Y.I. acquired MAVRICC, of Troy, Mich., from co-founders Kyle Kerbawy and Craig Moncher. Kerbawy and Moncher will remain active operating MAVRICC.
Kerbawy will be nominated to F.Y.I.'s board.
Input, of Grand Prairie, Texas, provides data capture services through two Dallas-area locations.
